posts.author: nomiss
posts.content_md: IS any one familiar with Kris Meerlo's work and how he creates such high quality holograms? IF you haven't seen his work, here is a link to his youtube channel [http://www.youtube.com/user/KrisMeerlo](http://www.youtube.com/user/KrisMeerlo). Also, what equipment would be needed to obtain a level of quality similar to this?

posts.author: holorefugee
posts.content_md: Last I talked to Kris he was using home made mounts on a 6" thick concrete table isolated with inner tubes using 8x10 plates with a HeNe laser.

posts.author: kris meerlo
posts.content_md:
I making holograms for many years, but the last 2 years i had no time for making holograms. I will soon start again.

And i lost my website now i make a new one [http://www.holography.info](http://www.holography.info).

It is under construction the final willbe ready the end of the month ( i hope ).

In the many years i making holograms i did it always with the same method, HeNe laser spatial filter big mirror single beam reflection, the only thing I changed was the holomaterial. And i can tell you the Ultimate plates are the best it sounds like a advertising but it is not.

I make also color holograms on ultimate plates and it is very easy to make them and with a unbelievable result look on my youtube site ( link on my webpage ).

Ok they are a little bit more expensive but you have a high sensitivity in combination with a high resolution and they are preshiffted.
